what: Recovery waterfall gates `_surface_ci_stderr_tail` on `tier_rc -ne 0`, but `launch-codex-ci.sh` / `launch-cursor-ci.sh` always `exit 0` and encode agent failure in `LAUNCHER_EXIT` KV on stdout (discarded via `>/dev/null`)
scenario_or_breakage: Agent failure in recovery still leaves `${output}.stderr-tail` on disk (from `run-external-agent.sh`) while `tier_rc` stays 0, so the planned surfacing never runs and chat stays silent on a documented lane
suggested_fix: Surface when `${output}.stderr-tail` is non-empty after each tier attempt (or capture launcher stdout and treat non-zero `LAUNCHER_EXIT` like the CI fix-loop), not only when `tier_rc -ne 0`
